description:
Your cloned voices, oldest first, one cursor page at a time. Call it with
no `cursor`, then pass back the `next_cursor` you were handed until it is
`null`.

Once a voice is `ready`, its `voice_id` is the provider voice id to put
in an agent's `voice.voice_id` with `voice.provider: cartesia`.

(Tags: Voice cloning)

cursor.description:
The `next_cursor` from your previous response. Omit it on the first
request. Opaque: pass it back unchanged.

limit.description: Rows per page. Above 100 the request is refused.

name: listClonedVoices
